title: Which physical frame contains the page?
source_reference: Week 10/CG227Lect8.pptx, slide 7, “Logical Address Translation”. Keep page table 2,7,1,5 and frames; remove the printed formula. Give page/frame size = 256 bytes. For turn 4, a clean second image with page 2's entry changed to 4 is preferable to a text-only edit.
notes: Source-based images prepared and visually checked. See data/image_sources/manifest.json for provenance and data/image_sources/review.html for full-resolution review.

turns.student_message: If the CPU asks for logical page 2, offset 10, where does that land in the physical memory pictured?
I got 2x256+10. Which number in the diagram should replace that first 2, and why?
If I choose offset 200 on the same logical page, does the physical frame change, or just the place within it?
Now the page-2 entry is changed from frame 1 to frame 4. Which part of the physical address changes, and what does it become for offset 10?
If the entry were marked not present instead, could we still take the same arrow straight to a frame?
